Messages.Author: Lemminkäinen
Messages.Body:
Does using Blind Spot on a Vampire with Secure Haven cost an extra pool? I'm guessing the answer is the same no matter if you play it yourself or your predator plays it on you.

Blind Spot
Master

Master.
Choose a vampire you control and an ally or younger vampire controlled by your prey. While the first chosen vampire is acting this turn, the other chosen minion cannot block or play reaction cards.

Secure Haven
Master
1 pool

Master: unique location. Haven.
Put this card on a minion you control. This minion cannot be the target of other Methuselahs' actions. Any Methuselah burns an additional pool when playing master cards on (or that target) this minion. Burn this card if this minion enters torpor. A minion may have only one haven.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Blind Spot would cost 1 additional pool indeed.
